input_scope.formula: 2CNF with unit/binary clauses; empty clause allowed only as explicit UNSAT result
input_scope.boundary: explicit subset B of formula variables
input_scope.external_context: arbitrary additional CNF R may share only B with eliminated internal variables; exact replacement theorem is semantic and does not assume R tractable

canonicalization.clause_order: deterministic by length then canonical literal tuple

candidate_mechanism.single_elimination: To eliminate x, retain clauses not containing +/-x; for every C+ containing x and C- containing -x, add the non-tautological resolvent (C+\{x}) union (C-\{-x}); then canonicalize.
candidate_mechanism.width_invariant: For width<=2 parents, every non-tautological resolvent after removing x has width<=2.
candidate_mechanism.projection: Repeat exact elimination for every x in I. The final boundary receipt Q(B) is the canonical remaining 2CNF.
candidate_mechanism.unsat_representation: A canonical empty clause represents the identically false boundary relation.
candidate_mechanism.sat_reconstruction: Given a boundary assignment accepted by Q, reconstruct/verify an internal extension by solving the original F conditioned on B with the frozen exact 2SAT solver; no exponential reverse trace is required.

semantic_targets.pointwise_projection: For every assignment beta to B: beta satisfies Q iff there exists assignment iota to I such that beta union iota satisfies F.
semantic_targets.contextual_replacement: For every external formula R sharing no internal variable from I: SAT(F(B,I) and R(B,Z)) iff SAT(Q(B) and R(B,Z)).

proof_obligations.P1: Single-variable Davis-Putnam elimination is exactly equivalent to existential quantification of x.
proof_obligations.P2: Every elimination step preserves width<=2 after tautology removal.
proof_obligations.P3: Repeated canonical elimination yields exact Q(B)=exists I F(B,I), independent of finite tests.
proof_obligations.P4: Canonical receipt contains at most polynomially many distinct unit/binary clauses; an O(k^2) final boundary-size bound is sufficient.
proof_obligations.P5: Construction is polynomial despite pairwise resolution; a conservative polynomial upper bound from canonical clause-count limits is sufficient.
proof_obligations.P6: Given beta satisfying Q, internal witness reconstruction/verification via original conditioned 2SAT is polynomial and exact.
proof_obligations.P7: Contextual replacement with arbitrary R is semantics preserving because eliminated variables I occur nowhere in R.

complexity_target.naive_pair_generation_per_eliminated_var: O(m^4) worst-case from O(m^2) positive/negative-containing clause sets
complexity_target.acceptable_conservative_total: O(n^5) canonical resolution work plus polynomial sorting/dedup and 2SAT reconstruction

required_falsifiers: independent pointwise truth comparison on exhaustive small 2CNF controls
wide boundary control with |B| > floor(log2 L) showing polynomial receipt bytes/clauses without assignment-table enumeration
contextual replacement controls with an external formula sharing only B

anti_overclaim.scientific_value: This target establishes an exact polynomial-size projected relation representation usable as a typed message/morph inside mixed decompositions; it is not a new proof that 2SAT is in P.
